Job Title:

Operations Technical Training Platforms Co-Op

Job Description:

Here at Entegris, we use advanced science to enable technologies that transform the world, and we are seeking employees who have the drive to continue the mission.

The Role:
Our site in Colorado Springs, CO is seeking an Operations Technical Training Platforms Co-Op to join our team for the Spring 2027 season. This assignment is intended to be full-time, 6 months in duration. This position also has potential to be based in our HQ in Billerica, MA.

The Operations Technical Training Platforms Co-Op will support learning technology administration, Learning Management System (LMS) implementation readiness, data governance, analytics, and continuous improvement initiatives. Through collaboration with stakeholders across Operations, Quality, HR, IT, Environmental Health and Safety, and site training teams, this role will help improve data quality, support enterprise technology initiatives, develop reporting and dashboard solutions, and measure the business impact of training governance and standardization efforts across Entegris' global manufacturing network.

What You’ll Do:

- Support Learning Management System (LMS) technology implementation readiness activities by partnering with site training administrators to improve the quality, consistency, and governance of training data and processes.

- Support initiatives to standardize and document training-related business processes, governance practices, and system structures in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders.

- Track and report progress against LMS migration readiness goals, including data cleanup activities, remediation actions, and site readiness metrics.

- Measure and quantify the business impact of governance and cleanup efforts, including reductions in duplicate records, obsolete content, unnecessary assignments, and other legacy system complexity.

- Perform basic LMS technology administrative activities and provide first-level support for learning technology users, including assisting with user troubleshooting and ServiceNow ticket resolution.

- Develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations using tools such as Excel and Power BI to communicate program progress, data quality improvements, and operational performance.

What We Seek:

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.

- Demonstrated attention to detail and ability to organize, analyze, and manage large amounts of information.

- Experience using Microsoft Excel for data analysis, reporting, visualization, or process tracking.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document processes and communicate findings.

- Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a cross-functional environment.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a dynamic business environment. Interest in business systems, data analytics, process improvement, digital transformation, learning technologies, or technology implementation projects.

- Ability to handle sensitive business information with professionalism and confidentiality.

Preferred Majors: Management Information Systems (MIS)Information Systems Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Human Resources, Organizational Development
Preferred Graduation Date: 2027 or 2028

- Must be a currently enrolled student

- Available to work 40 hours a week, M-F (8a-5p) beginning in January through June

- Must be familiar with the university’s requirements to participate in a co-op program

Ability to perform work in a standard office environment, including prolonged periods of sitting, standing, and computer use.

Lead. Inspire. Innovate. Define Your Future.
